main_text.p: dis hæ scriptæ, signataque : Omnes & singuli totius provinciæ ordines, qui Amasfo & Lavicâ continentur, retinerent jura & privilegia sua per manus à majoribus accepta, leges patrias, statuta, consuetudines: imperium Præfectura veteris, & Selwerdicæ suburbanæ esset ac maneret civitatis: munitiones per agrum omnes, quæ jam essent, everto-rentur; nec aliæ in futurum extruerentur, nisi id defensionis requireret necessitas: domus Principe digna, sed inermis & immunita Cæsari ædificaretur in urbe, sumptibus provinciæ totius: reditus ex agro solveren-tur Cæsari & hæredibus ejus quotannis duodecies mille aureorum Carolinorum. Dammona capta à Teuteburgio totâ Drentiâ Geldri ejecti, Wedda, Coverdiaque captæ, bellum ex universâ illâ vicinia, eodem adhuc anno profligatum. Denique Decembri mense pax interBur-gundiam domum & Geldrum composi-ta. Conditiones dictæ inter alias, ut fæ-deri Gallico, Holsatico, aliisque contra Cæ-sarem & subditos ejus initis, Geldrus re-nunciaret: valediceret juri omni in civita-tem & agrum Groninganum, Drentiam,
main_text.notes: The italic/roman boundary in the last lines is uncertain: "Conditiones dictæ inter alias, ut fæ-" appears roman, the rest from "deri" appears italic. "interBur-" is printed without a space; left as printed. The running head's "o" in "Groninga" may carry a diacritic; read as plain o. The text runs on to the next page at "Tuen-", so the paragraph is not closed here.
